newsitem.title: USA: Booth American to sell cable television systems.
newsitem.headline: Booth American to sell cable television systems.

text.p: Booth American Co said Wednesday it will sell various cable television systems serving a total of about 146,000 U.S. households to other providers including U S West Media Group and Adelphia Communications Corp.

Booth's Birmingham and Summit Township, Michigan, systems are to be sold to U S West. The systems serve about 40,000 subscribers and are contiguous to Continental Cablevision systems serving 345,000 Michigan households. Continental merged with U S West and will manage the operations.
Booth said it entered into agreements with Adelphia and its affiliates to sell systems serving about 32,000 subscribers in Virginia and Florida.
The company said it also expects to close in early 1997 the sale of its North and South Carolina cable systems to Helicon Partners I LP, which serve some 35,000 subscribers.
Booth also said definitive agreements were signed to sell the cable service to all but 33,000 subscribers in Southern California.
Earlier this year Booth sold its Kern Valley, California, system serving about 6,400 subscribers to Mediacom LLC. ((--Chicago newsdesk, 312-408-8787))
